# Load resources

```{r}
#| label: load packages
#| message: false # removes tidyverse loader & here location for privacy
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tidymodels)
library(probably)
library(ggrepel)

source(here("functions", "set_env-variables.R"))
source(file.path(PATH_FUNCTIONS, "load_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load best model config

selected_config <- load_selected_config(threshold = FALSE)
selected_wf <- load_selected_wf()
```

```{r}
#| label: load train dataset

train_df <- load_imputed_df(selected_config[["imp"]])
```

# Get Predictions

Done for best performing model in threshold-independent roc curve setting.

```{r}
#| label: create threshold splits

th_folds <- split_vfold(train_df, strata = "depression_phq4_binary_in_1y", v = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: get predictions for each split

th_preds <- selected_wf %>%
  fit_resamples(th_folds, control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)) %>%
  collect_predictions()
```

```{r}
#| label: save threshold predictions

save_predicted_df(th_preds, "threshold")
```

```{r}
#| label: load threshold predictions

th_preds <- load_predicted_df("threshold")
```

# Generate Metrics

```{r}
#| label: set metrics

# custom wrapper function for f2 metric, as false negative more costly than false positive
f2_meas <- metric_tweak(
  "f2_meas",
  f_meas,
  beta = 2
)

f05_meas <- metric_tweak(
  "f05_meas",
  f_meas,
  beta = 0.5
)

th_metric_labels <- c(
  # first listed is the one used for threshold picking
  f2_meas = "F2-Score",
  bal_accuracy = "Balanced Accuracy",
  j_index = "Youden's J Statistic",
  f_meas = "F1-Score",
  f05_meas = "F0.5-Score",
  mcc = "Matthews Correlation Coefficient",
  accuracy = "Accuracy", # not ideal for imbalance but included for comparison, not relevant to decision.
  precision = "Precision",
  recall = "Recall"
)

# th_metric_set <- do.call(metric_set, map(names(th_metric_labels), get))
```

```{r}
#| label: compute overall threshold metrics
#| warning: false


compute_threshold_metrics <- function(data,
                                      truth = "depression_phq4_binary_in_1y",
                                      estimate = ".pred_TRUE",
                                      metrics_key,
                                      na_rm = TRUE,
                                      candidates = seq(0, 1, 0.001)) {
  #' Threshold Metrics Calculator
  #'
  #' uses probably::threshold_perf to get performance metrics for every point in specified sequence given model predictions.
  #' Renames Metrics to names specified in metrics_key. Removes estimator type, is known information.
  #'
  #' @param data : dataset containing truth and model predictions
  #' @param truth : colname of outcome variable
  #' @param estimate : colname of numeric col containing probabilities for 1 category of truth
  #' @param metrics_key : list in form of list(metricsfunction = "Name of Metric")
  #' @param na_rm : logical
  #' @param candidates : sequence of candidate thresholds to test
  #'
  #' @return tibble with columns .threshold, .metric and .estimate.

  metrics <- do.call(metric_set, map(names(metrics_key), get))

  th_metrics_df <- suppressWarnings( # i do this so it doesnt send thousands of "oh no cant calc precision due to 0 positive" warnings.
    threshold_perf(
      data,
      truth = !!sym(truth),
      estimate = !!sym(estimate),
      thresholds = candidates,
      metrics = metrics,
      na_rm = na_rm
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(.metric = factor(
      .metric,
      levels = names(metrics_key),
      labels = unname(metrics_key)
    )) %>%
    select(-.estimator)
}

th_metrics_df <- compute_threshold_metrics(th_preds, metrics_key = th_metric_labels)

th_metrics_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate) %>%
  slice(seq(1, nrow(.), floor(nrow(.) / 100 * 10))) %>% # showing 10 rows for conciseness
  export_return("07_threshold_metric-sample",
    caption = "Performance metrics for a selection of all candidate thresholds based on the pooled CV predictions.",
    label = "threshold_metric-sample"
  )
```

F1 Score and Precision are not computable at some point due to all predictions resulting in FALSE.

# Find optima

```{r}
#| label: find maximization thresholds

# identifies first point where max occurs
th_optima_df <- th_metrics_df %>%
  group_by(.metric) %>%
  arrange(desc(.estimate), .threshold) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  relocate(.metric, .threshold, .estimate)


selected_th <- th_optima_df %>%
  filter(.metric == th_metric_labels[[1]]) %>%
  pull(.threshold)

th_optima_df %>%
  export_return("07_threshold_metric-maximizations", caption = "Classification thresholds that maximize given metrics based on the pooled CV predictions.", label = "threshold_metric-maximizations")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot thresholds for all metrics
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

th_metrics_df %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = .threshold, y = .estimate)) +
  facet_wrap(~.metric, nrow = 3, scales = "free") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_area(fill = 1, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(
    data = th_optima_df,
    aes(xintercept = .threshold),
    linewidth = 1,
    color = 4
  ) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = th_optima_df,
    aes(
      x = .threshold,
      y = .estimate,
      label = paste0("th = ", .threshold, ",\nest = ", round(.estimate, 3), "")
    ),
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 2
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines")) +
  color_qualitative() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Classification Threshold",
    y = "Metric",
    title = "Model Metrics by Threshold",
    subtitle = "First occurence of maximum indicated with vertical line",
    caption = paste0(
      "Selected Model: ",
      selected_config[["wf"]],
      ",\nSelected Imputation Strategy: ",
      selected_config[["imp"]]
    )
  ) -
  partial(export_return, filename = "07_thresholds-metrics", width = 10, height = 10)
```

# Sensitivity Testing - Metrics per Fold

```{r}
#| label: get maximizing metrics per fold

th_folds_metrics_df <- th_preds %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  group_map(~ {
    compute_threshold_metrics(.x, metrics_key = th_metric_labels) %>%
      bind_cols(.y, .)
  }, .keep = TRUE) %>%
  bind_rows()

th_folds_metrics_df
```

```{r}
#| label: summary statistics about per fold distribution

th_folds_metrics_df %>%
  # keep only maximum for each fold
  group_by(id, .metric) %>%
  arrange(desc(.estimate), .threshold) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # statistics per metric
  group_by(.metric) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(.threshold),
    q1 = quantile(.threshold, 0.25),
    q3 = quantile(.threshold, 0.75),
    iqr = IQR(.threshold),
    range = max(.threshold) - min(.threshold),
    sd = sd(.threshold),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(
    "Optimized Metric" = .metric,
    "Threshold: Median" = median,
    Q1 = q1,
    Q3 = q3,
    IQR = iqr,
    Range = range
  ) %>%
  export_return("07_thresholds-distribution",
    caption = "Summary statistics of the distribution of metric-maximizing thresholds across the 10 CV folds. Values shown are threshold values, not metric estimates.",
    label = "threshold_distribution_summary",
    tabular.environment = "tabular",
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    vline.after = c(1)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: F2 per fold distribution
```

```{r}
#| label: plot distribution of fold thresholds
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10


th_folds_metrics_df %>%
  # keep only maximum for each fold
  group_by(id, .metric) %>%
  arrange(desc(.estimate), .threshold) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # plot results
  ggplot(aes(x = .metric, y = .threshold)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = id), width = 0.1, height = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 45,
    vjust = 1,
    hjust = 1
  )) +
  color_qualitative() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Performance Metric",
    y = "Threshold",
    title = "Distribution of metric-maximizing thresholds",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Distribution based on ",
      n_distinct(th_preds$id),
      " vfold resamples"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Selected Model: ",
      selected_config[["wf"]],
      ",\nSelected Imputation Strategy: ",
      selected_config[["imp"]]
    )
  ) -
  partial(export_return,
    filename = "07_thresholds-sensitivity",
    width = 10,
    height = 10
  )
```
